findings.description: This KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled (AWS default is false). A key protecting an audit-log bucket that uses the same key material indefinitely increases the blast radius and temporal exposure if the key material is ever compromised, and prevents meeting common compliance baselines that require rotation.
